activity.notes: Tutankhamun was an Eighteenth Dynasty pharaoh of New Kingdom Egypt. Modern museum chronologies place his reign approximately in 1336-1327 BCE; both boundaries are therefore stored as approximate rather than converting a reconstructed chronology into exact years.

sources.title: Tutankhamun — The Metropolitan Museum of Art
sources.citation_text: The Metropolitan Museum of Art places Tutankhamun's reign approximately in 1336-1327 BCE.
